policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O: Hugging Face breach technical deep-dive
items.summary: O released a technical report describing warning signs and how agents accessed third-party environments, alongside implications for future safety practices after the Hugging Face incident.

items.headline: O: Astra release pacing tied to cyber threshold
items.summary: O described model-development pacing after internal evidence suggested an upcoming model (Astra) could meet a critical cybersecurity capability threshold, alongside related risk signals.

items.headline: G: $350M Series A to scale GroqCloud
items.summary: G announced it closed a $350M Series A led by Disruptive with planned NVIDIA participation, explicitly tying proceeds to building its inference cloud (GroqCloud).

items.headline: O: GPT-5.6 updates (ChatGPT access)
items.summary: O published August deployment-safety hub updates for GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Luna, including how the models are treated under the Preparedness Framework across cyber and bio/chem capability areas.
